# Jacob G's Documentation

> > Personal documentation site covering high school coursework in biology, computer science, history, mathematics, and Spanish, plus personal music interests.

This is a student's comprehensive learning documentation, primarily focused on Grade 10 academic subjects including cellular biology (photosynthesis, respiration, genetics), American history (Revolutionary War, Industrial Revolution, Jacksonian era), computer science fundamentals, and language studies. The site also includes personal music listening notes.

## Key Topics

- Photosynthesis & Calvin Cycle
- Cellular Respiration & ATP
- Genetics & Inheritance
- Revolutionary War
- Industrial Revolution & Antebellum South
- Andrew Jackson & Jacksonian Democracy
- Cybersecurity & Digital Media
- Git & Collaboration Tools
- George Washington
- Eli Whitney & Cotton Gin
- Electron Transport Chain
- G3P & RuBP
- Trail of Tears & Indian Removal
- Algebra 2 & Quadratics
- Spanish Cultural Comparison

## Biology: Cellular Processes & Energy

- [Glucose](https://docs.jacobg.co/school/grade-10/biology/Glucose): Glucose synthesis in photosynthesis via Calvin Cycle and G3P
- [RuBP](https://docs.jacobg.co/school/grade-10/biology/RuBP): RuBP in Calvin Cycle: carbon fixation with RuBisCO enzyme
- [Chemiosmosis](https://docs.jacobg.co/school/grade-10/biology/Chemiosmosis): Chemiosmosis: ATP synthesis via proton gradient and ATP synthase
- [Anaerobic Respiration](https://docs.jacobg.co/school/grade-10/biology/Anaerobic-Respiration): Anaerobic respiration, fermentation, glycolysis without oxygen
- [Energy Diagram](https://docs.jacobg.co/school/grade-10/biology/Energy-Diagram): Energy diagrams: exergonic, endergonic reactions, activation energy
- [Entropy](https://docs.jacobg.co/school/grade-10/biology/Entropy): Entropy in biological systems, disorder, energy investment in cells

## Biology: Genetics

- [Genetics Study Guide](https://docs.jacobg.co/school/grade-10/biology/genetics-sg): Genetics study guide: inheritance, recombination, pedigrees, Mendelian laws
